fields.label: Core problem
fields.value: Coordinate desired software state across changing distributed compute infrastructure without requiring humans to manually orchestrate every machine and recovery action.

value.because: Controllers turn desired-state declarations into repeatable reconciliation loops.
Failure-induced divergence can trigger replacement/recovery actions.
Schedulers and workload controllers coordinate resource supply with workload demand.
A common API/object model abstracts workload management across machines, distributions and cloud environments.
CRDs, controllers, operators, scheduler extensions and CSI allow the platform to be adapted without changing the entire core.
The same declarative state model applies across workloads, networking, storage, configuration and infrastructure.

fields.label: Central insight
fields.value: Kubernetes is best understood as a distributed control system and extensible API platform, not merely as a tool that 'runs containers'.
